rule: Sidecar of the raid target: the target file stays byte-identical so the accepted Magmaw verdicts and the boss-level graph keep their pinned target_sha256. The target's top-level roster, validation_scenario_id and run_plan remain the accepted legacy shard (30001-30010). A label whose kill records all come from shard runs of one variant's validation scenario (record shard_identity.scenario_id) is judged against that variant's roster instead (tools/raid_program/scoreboard_core.target_for_records). Specs and roles still come from the roster, never from the run.

variants.roster_source: tools.raid_program.raid_shard_plan: packed identity raid 1, 10N, boss 0, copy 0 (character GUID 11000000 + slot); spec selection from experiments/configs/raid_compositions/blackwing_descent_10n.json (Magmaw: Balance druid, Elemental shaman)

run_plan.launcher: tools.raid_program.shard_coordinator (the canonical characters exist only through the raid_shard_provisioning plan, never the legacy validation provisioning)
run_plan.ingest: pixi run python -m tools.raid_program.scoreboard ingest --scenario blackwing_descent_10n_magmaw --label <label> --run-dir <output-dir>/shards/blackwing_descent_10n_magmaw_c0 (the flat single-shard run dir itself with --flat-shard-dir)
